name: Marc Lashner
ai_experience: Building AI and LLM applications focused on workflow automation, agentic systems, and healthcare use cases. Current work includes an AI-powered job-search platform using Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker, structured LLM workflows, and agentic orchestration. Uses AI-assisted development extensively for codebase exploration, architecture and implementation planning, coding, testing, debugging, review, and documentation. This represents current hands-on project experience rather than a claim of having previously shipped large-scale customer-facing LLM systems in production.
healthcare_experience: Built production software across healthcare and healthcare-adjacent operations, including healthcare payments and financial workflows, HIPAA-compliant medical-record software, laboratory and manufacturing workflows, and operational automation. Experience includes designing systems that route and manage operational work across laboratories based on capacity, priority, order type, and operating constraints.
leadership_experience: Technical and organizational leadership experience includes leading approximately 10 engineers at HealthOPX, developing and leading group and individual mentorship programs at Collective Health, operating in a Director of Product Development role earlier in career, and leading a 40-person rigging team outside of professional software engineering. Prefers a hands-on senior IC or technical-lead path rather than a pure people-management role.
summary: Senior software engineer with 7+ years of experience building full-stack products, backend services, distributed systems, and operational software, with substantial experience in healthcare and healthcare-adjacent workflows. Strong background in end-to-end product ownership, reliability, system design, and cross-functional engineering. Currently focused on AI-enabled product development, LLM workflows, and agentic systems, with particular interest in applying modern AI to real-world healthcare and operational problems.
